verdict.rationale: Appwrite documents an official MCP server that lets LLMs interact directly with its API and docs, and names supported clients such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Claude Desktop. A hosted MCP server is bundled into its Claude Code and Codex plugins with one-step OAuth sign-in, and a probe confirmed the MCP docs page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the MCP server works as described.
